records.context: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting independent execution path. This serializes that independent execution path's parallel regions without imposing a process-wide ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` limit on segmentation and other workloads. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#2
records.source: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting thread. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.translation: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` greinir vörpuð keyrsluumhverfi og, þegar fleiri en eitt er til staðar, kallar ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` á aðlögunarþræðinum. Þetta raðtengir samhliða svæði þess þráðar án þess að setja ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` takmörkun á allt ferlið fyrir bútun og annað álag. records.context: The microplate sample position is measured, not only cropped. Plaque *area* in pixels is a property of the microscope, not of the biology. The same plaque imaged at two magnifications gives two areas, and a study that pools them is comparing optics. A microplate sample position, by contrast, is a manufactured object of known physical size -- a 6-position laboratory microplate microplate sample position is 34.8 mm whatever images it. So the microplate sample position's diameter in pixels is a ruler that is present in the image itself, and dividing by it turns every area into a physical one that can be pooled across microscopes, objectives and days.

records.source: The well is measured, not only cropped. Plaque *area* in pixels is a property of the microscope, not of the biology. A well, by contrast, is a manufactured object of known physical size -- a 6-well plate well is 34.8 mm whatever images it. So the well's diameter in pixels is a ruler that is present in the image itself, and dividing by it turns every area into a physical one that can be pooled across microscopes, objectives and days.
records.translation: Brunnurinn er mældur, ekki aðeins klipptur út. *Flatarmál* skellu í dílum er eiginleiki smásjárinnar, ekki líffræðinnar. Brunnur er hins vegar framleiddur hlutur af þekktri raunstærð -- brunnur í 6 brunna plötu er 34.8 mm hvað sem myndar hann. Þvermál brunnsins í dílum er því reglustika sem er til staðar í myndinni sjálfri, og með því að deila með því verður hvert flatarmál að raunflatarmáli sem má sameina milli smásjáa, linsa og daga.
